info.title: Skiller API
info.description: Skiller platform backend. All routes are under /v1. Errors use the shared ErrorResponse envelope.

Money.description: Integer paise (1/100 rupee) as a decimal string. Never a JSON number: amounts can exceed 2^53.

refund.description: The order's live refund; null when none was asked for or it was rejected or failed.

limits.description: max_published_courses, storage_gb, reels_per_day, analytics_level, creator_coupons, org_seats, max_active_gigs (null = unlimited; max_active_gigs may be left out on write: the plan key's default applies).

details.description: Per check: counts and the mismatching items (amounts are Money strings).

limit.description: Bytes for storage_gb, a count otherwise; null = unlimited.

limits.description: max_published_courses, storage_gb, reels_per_day, analytics_level, creator_coupons, org_seats, max_active_gigs (null = unlimited; max_active_gigs may be left out on write: the plan key's default applies).

usage.description: Per limit key: storage_gb, max_published_courses, reels_per_day, org_seats, max_active_gigs.

SubscriptionChange.description: ON_PAYMENT (upgrade): open Razorpay checkout with the returned ids. AT_PERIOD_END (downgrade): booked for the period end.

cooldownEndsAt.description: Payouts are blocked until this moment.

underReview.description: Payouts are held until our team has checked the account.

details.description: Code-specific data, e.g. `fields` for validation errors or `retryAfterSec` for rate limits.

requestId.description: Also returned in the `x-request-id` response header.
